name: Joy Bangla Concert 2017 (3rd edition)
organizer: Young Bangla / Centre for Research and Information (CRI)
notes: Third edition. Eight-band bill spanning heavy metal (Warfaze, Cryptic Fate), alternative and nu-metal (Nemesis, Arbovirus, Shunno), progressive/psychedelic rock (Shironamhin) and folk fusion (Lalon, Chirkutt) on one stage — the cross-strand billing pattern that makes this series the densest single source of preference-network edges in the catalogue. Billing roles beyond the reported running order are inferred from each act's standing at the time and should be treated as approximate.
